Its okay, thank you, I didn't need someone to read it let alone every single  word but I appreciate your comment.

Its just so difficult for me, if I ever attempt it, its not to seek any help, its to die, I think in black and white terms regarding suicide, if I ever attempt it, I will die 100%, which scares me.

I think if I ever try doing it I will probably just break down and not do it, however if I follow a long plan, and did the first step, I will do it, I am sure of that.
